theme: cache/tmp reclaim KEEPBIGGER KEEPSMALLER RMALL TOUCHALL bulk GC

tests.name: reclaim_big
tests.cmd: RMALL cand → rm_n=2 mid+big gone tiny remains

tests.name: rmall_dir_fail
tests.cmd: RMALL files+dir → rm_n=2 rm_fail=1 nested remains

weaknesses.title: KEEPBIGGER/KEEPSMALLER reject numeric vars — STR shuttle required
weaknesses.detail: Same class as FRESH: size limit is TK_NUM literal or string only. SYS KEEPBIGGER bag MIN with num MIN fails parse. Agents must SYS STR MIN first.
weaknesses.repro: LET MIN=10; SYS KEEPBIGGER paths MIN → fail; STR then ok

weaknesses.title: RMALL cannot remove directories — FAIL, nested trees leftover
weaknesses.detail: Dirs count as RMALL_FAIL not recursive delete. GC of PATHGLOB * without KEEPFILES leaves empty dir trees. No RMDIR/RMALL_R.
weaknesses.repro: RMALL bag_with_dir → rm_fail>=1; ISDIR nested still 1

weaknesses.title: TOUCHALL creates files but not parent directories
weaknesses.detail: ENSURE deep path without MKDIR parents fails soft (TOUCHALL_FAIL). Agents need MKDIR glue for nested leases.

weaknesses.title: RMALL/TOUCHALL set OK=0 on any fail while still removing others
weaknesses.detail: Partial success: rm_n>0 but OK=0 when dir fail present. -s strict agents may treat as hard fail if sticky ERR not CLEAR_ERR.

weaknesses.title: No exclusive size range filter (min AND max in one op)
weaknesses.detail: Mid-band reclaim needs KEEPBIGGER then KEEPSMALLER chain. No KEEPSIZEBETWEEN.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON bag newline collapse
weaknesses.detail: Removed path bags collapse in JSON line.

weaknesses.title: Stale CAND plate can reclaim wrong set if not cleared after scan
weaknesses.detail: Agent glue: reclaim prefers CAND over PATHS when CAND non-empty. Rescan without clear cand deletes old filter set not new inventory. Language has no paired plate invalidation.
weaknesses.repro: big; scan; reclaim without clear → deletes old cand

workarounds: KEEPFILES before RMALL to avoid dir FAIL noise
CLEAR cand after scan or always write cand from latest filter
CLEAR_ERR after partial RMALL if rm_n>0 is success
MKDIR parents before TOUCHALL nested markers
issues_faced: KEEPBIGGER+RMALL+TOUCHALL positive path clean with STR shuttle
